summary: Frontend-only validation of OPC Dashboard 'Sources de données connectées' card. All 6 sources render with correct data-testid opc-source-0..5. First 3 (France Compétences RNCP/RS, France Travail ROME 4.0, Base RE'ACTIF PRO) are non-clickable DIVs styled in emerald green. Last 3 European sources (EURES, ESCO, CEDEFOP) are proper <a> anchors with target=_blank and exact expected href values, styled in blue with visible ExternalLink icon. Dashboard KPIs, Actualiser button and Répartition RNCP par niveau still render (no regression). Tailwind classes render correctly (no broken styling).
